why: Must_not item 2 holds: Checks 1–3 all run the bin with real files and stdin, so no behaviour line is passed just by reading the code. Item 1 fails. Line 4 only says "lint(text) in src/index.js is unchanged", but Check 4 asks for the whole file to match a fixed sha256 hash and to show no `git diff` at all. So any edit elsewhere in src/index.js fails the check even if lint stays the same, which in effect limits which files the PR may touch. The builder brief says the same thing: "do not touch ... src/index.js at all (not even whitespace)". Check 6 is also stricter than line 6: it requires "exactly one open PR", so a merged PR would fail, and the line asks only for one PR. Check 3 also requires that stderr names missing.jsonl, which the line does not ask for.
